title: [main] Purchase invoice fails with "quantity larger than item ledger entry" after partial invoicing of multiple receipts with non-base UoM and Qty. Rounding Precision = 1
summary: Fixes a posting issue where partial purchase invoices with non-base units of measure and quantity rounding could fail when multiple receipts were involved, by ensuring remaining receipt quantities are correctly applied for equal quantities.
key_points: Changed quantity comparison from greater-than to greater-than-or-equal to properly handle remaining receipt base quantities
Fixes posting failures that occurred after partial invoicing of multiple receipts with specific rounding precision settings
Added regression test coverage across applicable localization layers to prevent recurrence
quote: Use a greater-than-or-equal comparison so posted receipt base quantities are used for equal quantities as well.
